blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Французское слово «amour» пришло из окситанского языка через ___ (трубадур, acc. pl.), а иначе бы оно было «ameur».
exercises.prompt: The French word "amour" comes from the Occitan language through the troubadours, otherwise it would be "ameur".
exercises.why: **трубадур → трубадуров** (acc. pl.). Masculine, animate; nominative plural трубадуры. Declines like DLI's студент — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. студентов). Ending — (no ending) → -ов.  Declension: sg. трубадур · трубадура · трубадуру · трубадура · трубадуром · трубадуре; pl. трубадуры · трубадуров · трубадурам · трубадуров · трубадурами · трубадурах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Про ___ (приданое, acc. sg.) не спросил даже.
exercises.why: **приданое → приданое** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -е. A noun that declines like an adjective (an adjective used as a noun): it takes adjective endings, not noun endings. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. приданое · приданого · приданому · приданое · приданым · приданом; pl. приданые · приданых · приданым · приданые · придаными · приданых.  «Больной, раненый and знакомый are often used as adjectival nouns.» — DLI, Lesson 57.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сквозь ___ (пятнистый ствол, acc. pl.) играла вдали сияющая вода озера.
exercises.why: **ствол → стволы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural стволы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  **пятнистый → пятнистые** (acc. pl., agreeing with стволы). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. ствол · ствола · стволу · ствол · стволом · стволе; pl. стволы · стволов · стволам · стволы · стволами · стволах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Если бы у меня были крылья, я бы перелетела через ___ (гора, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: If I had wings, I'd fly over the mountains.
exercises.why: **гора → горы** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural горы. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -ы.  Declension: sg. гора · горы · горе · гору · горой · горе; pl. горы · гор · горам · горы · горами · горах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ты про ___ (любовница, acc. sg.) Хвощинского, что ли?.
exercises.why: **любовница → любовницу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's сестра — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. любовница · любовницы · любовнице · любовницу · любовницей · любовнице; pl. любовницы · любовниц · любовницам · любовниц · любовницами · любовницах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сквозь ___ (каменный сон, acc. sg.) услышал Барыба колокол — к Ильинской обедне.
exercises.why: **сон → сон** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **каменный → каменный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with сон). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. сон · сна · сну · сон · сном · сне; pl. сны · снов · снам · сны · снами · снах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Адвокаты первой инстанции не смогли пробиться через ___ (тактика, acc. sg.) блокирования главы мафии.
exercises.prompt: The trial lawyers couldn't get past the Mafia leader's stonewalling tactics.
exercises.why: **тактика → тактику** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. тактика · тактики · тактике · тактику · тактикой · тактике; pl. тактики · тактик · тактикам · тактики · тактиками · тактиках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Можно сказать ему про ___ (ложка, acc. sg.)?
exercises.why: **ложка → ложку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. ложка · ложки · ложке · ложку · ложкой · ложке; pl. ложки · ложек · ложкам · ложки · ложками · ложках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Преступнику набавили рабочего сроку и провели сквозь ___ (тысяча, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **тысяча → тысячу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. тысяча · тысячи · тысяче · тысячу · тысячей · тысяче; pl. тысячи · тысяч · тысячам · тысячи · тысячами · тысячах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**минута → минуту** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Про ___ (случай, acc. sg.) этот, пожалуй, стоит рассказать.
exercises.why: **случай → случай** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -й. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. случай · случая · случаю · случай · случаем · случае; pl. случаи · случаев · случаям · случаи · случаями · случаях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я увидал их обоих сквозь ___ (негустой переплёт, acc. sg.) ветвей.
exercises.why: **переплёт → переплет** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **негустой → негустой** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with переплет). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. переплёт · переплёта · переплёту · переплёт · переплётом · переплёте; pl. переплёты · переплётов · переплётам · переплёты · переплётами · переплётах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Значит, через ___ (полгода, acc. sg.) я стал другим человеком?
exercises.why: **полгода → полгода** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -а. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. полгода · полугода · полугоду · полгода · полугодом · полугоде; pl. — · — · — · — · — · —.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: А про ___ (англичанин, acc. sg.) когда вычитал?
exercises.why: **англичанин → англичанина** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's студент — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  Declension: sg. англичанин · англичанина · англичанину · англичанина · англичанином · англичанине; pl. англичане · англичан · англичанам · англичан · англичанами · англичанах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Терек прорылся сквозь ___ (обвал, acc. sg.) не прежде, как через два часа.
exercises.prompt: *Александр Пушкин, «Путешествие в Арзрум во время похода 1829 года»*
exercises.why: **обвал → обвал** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. обвал · обвала · обвалу · обвал · обвалом · обвале; pl. обвалы · обвалов · обвалам · обвалы · обвалами · обвалах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: А что слышно про ___ (японец, acc. pl.)?
exercises.why: **японец → японцев** (acc. pl.). Masculine, animate; nominative plural японцы. Declines like DLI's студент — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. студентов). Ending — (no ending) → -ев, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: японц- + -ев.  Declension: sg. японец · японца · японцу · японца · японцем · японце; pl. японцы · японцев · японцам · японцев · японцами · японцах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**дрёма → дрёму** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. дрёма · дрёмы · дрёме · дрёму · дрёмой · дрёме; pl. дрёмы · дрём · дрёмам · дрёмы · дрёмами · дрёмах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я знаю про ___ (царь, acc. sg.) Петра — этого с ним не было!
exercises.why: **царь → царя** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's учитель — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. учителя). Ending -ь → -я.
